page.overview:
Who is Soong?

Soong is a character who appeared in Street Fighter II V who appeared in Episode 10. He is a officer who works under Raja of the Bangkok Airport, but in reality is a spy from Ashura. Dorai has him exposed by several Ashura henchmen who were captured in Hong Kong when Soong tipped them off to undercover operatives. He has also tried to use false information to throw the police off the trail.

After Ryu and Ken have captured Donu and his henchmen for framing the former, Soong and Raja are taasked with interrogating the major henchman of Ashura. Suddenly, Zochi calls up Soong and the henchman kills Donu to silence him.
